Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to handle daily sales and inventory record-keeping, manage receipts and documentation, and provide light administrative support as needed.
	This role is ideal for an organized, trustworthy individual who can independently manage daily record-keeping tasks with minimal supervision.


Key Responsibilities
Sales Recording:


	Record and compile daily sales figures every morning from field/van sales and outlet reports
	Reconcile daily sales figures against cash/bank remittances where applicable
	Prepare simple daily/weekly sales summary reports for management
	Flag discrepancies or missing reports promptly


Inventory &amp; Stock Records:


	Track daily stock movement &mdash; incoming raw materials/finished goods and outgoing dispatches

	Maintain an accurate, up-to-date inventory log
	Flag low-stock levels or discrepancies promptly


Receipts &amp; General Admin:


	Collect, organize, and file receipts and supporting documents accurately
	Maintain proper filing and documentation of sales, inventory, and expense records
	Provide light administrative support as needed


Requirements


	OND / HND / Bachelor&#39;s Degree in any relevant field
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers and records
	Proficiency in Excel/basic spreadsheet tools
	Good organizational and time-management skills
	Trustworthy and able to handle records/receipts responsibly
	Ability to resume early and work independently each morning
	Prior admin, sales, or inventory experience is an advantage but not required


Salary
N100,000 - N120,000 per month.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: humanresources@crossbeverage.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.",

        Cross Beverage Company Limited is a Nigerian startup producing a portfolio of affordable, daily consumed drink products.Our products positions us to meet both everyday hydration needs and the demand for flavored, wholesome beverage in the Nigerian market

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Administrative Assistant

Job Location: Ibadan, Oyo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to handle daily sales and inventory record-keeping, manage receipts and documentation, and provide light administrative support as needed.
	This role is ideal for an organized, trustworthy individual who can independently manage daily record-keeping tasks with minimal supervision.


Key Responsibilities
Sales Recording:


	Record and compile daily sales figures every morning from field/van sales and outlet reports
	Reconcile daily sales figures against cash/bank remittances where applicable
	Prepare simple daily/weekly sales summary reports for management
	Flag discrepancies or missing reports promptly


Inventory & Stock Records:


	Track daily stock movement — incoming raw materials/finished goods and outgoing dispatches
	Conduct regular stock counts and reconcile physical stock against records
	Maintain an accurate, up-to-date inventory log
	Flag low-stock levels or discrepancies promptly


Receipts & General Admin:


	Collect, organize, and file receipts and supporting documents accurately
	Maintain proper filing and documentation of sales, inventory, and expense records
	Provide light administrative support as needed


Requirements


	OND / HND / Bachelor's Degree in any relevant field
	Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers and records
	Proficiency in Excel/basic spreadsheet tools
	Good organizational and time-management skills
	Trustworthy and able to handle records/receipts responsibly
	Ability to resume early and work independently each morning
	Prior admin, sales, or inventory experience is an advantage but not required


Salary
N100,000 - N120,000 per month.

Method of Application

Assistant General Manager (AGM) - Sales Job at Ascentech Services Limited




        
    

        
        Ascentech Services Limited is a human resources solutions company dedicated to helping businesses build stronger teams and manage people functions more effectively. Established in Nigeria in 2013, we have supported organizations for years with high-quality, practical HR services designed to meet real business needs; adapting to evolving workforce demands and enabling long-term growth. With a strong presence in Lagos and Ibadan, and an expanding footprint through Ascentforce in India, we deliver a broader, more connected approach to recruitment, outsourcing, training, and ongoing HR support. Ascentech brings expertise across borders, backed by over 13 years of dedicated experience in delivering practical HR and recruitment solutions.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Assistant General Manager (AGM) - Sales

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Automobile / Oil & Gas / Energy / Engineering / Related Industries
Reporting To: General Manager / Managing Director

Job Summary


	We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Assistant General Manager (AGM) to support business operations, drive growth, and oversee key commercial and operational activities.
	The ideal candidate should have strong experience in Automobile, Oil & Gas, Energy, Engineering, or other related industries, with proven leadership, business development, and management capabilities.


Key Responsibilities


	Support the General Manager / Managing Director in the overall management of business operations.
	Develop and implement strategies to achieve sales, revenue, and business growth targets.
	Identify and develop new business opportunities and strategic partnerships.
	Manage key client and stakeholder relationships.
	Lead, supervise, and motivate teams to achieve business objectives.
	Monitor market trends, competitors, and industry developments.
	Oversee budgets, performance targets, and operational efficiency.
	Prepare management reports and provide recommendations to senior management.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, industry standards, and applicable regulations.
	Represent the company in meetings, negotiations, and other business engagements.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Management, or a related field.
	8–12 years of relevant professional experience, with significant management experience.
	Relevant professional certifications or an MBA will be an advantage.
	Candidates from the Automobile, Oil & Gas, Energy, Engineering, Manufacturing, Industrial, or similar sectors are encouraged to apply.
	Proven experience in business development, sales, operations, or general management.
	Strong leadership, negotiation, communication, and decision-making skills.
	Strong commercial and strategic thinking abilities.
	Ability to manage teams, clients, and multiple business priorities effectively.


Salary
N900,000 - N1,000,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV  to: [email protected] using "Assistant General Manager – Victoria Island, Lagos" as the subject of the email.
